mapper.insert: insert into sys_user(username, password, real_name, phone, salary, role, remark, avatar, gender, age, address, create_time) values(#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{salary}, #{role}, #{remark}, #{avatar}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{address}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select count(*) from sys_user where role = 1
select count(*) from sys_user where role = 1 and username like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
select count(*) from sys_user where password = #{password}
select count(*) from sys_user where phone like concat(#{phone}, '%') or phone like concat('%|', #{phone})
select count(*) from sys_user where role = 0
